answer: Late-Cluster Graph Attribution: cluster new identities by shared timing and action traces, then score each cluster’s graph coherence. Enforce a rule: identities whose traces merge into one tight vine of correlated activity surrender rewards to a wider random baseline; lone stragglers keep theirs. An attacker must run separate timing, funding, and interaction graphs per identity, multiplying setup and monitoring cost. A summit of coordinated fakes still collapses to one penalty cluster once ember-like cross-links appear.
